title: peer offline: TCP 443 times out
why: The peer can be off, asleep, or behind a dropped ACL; all three look like a timeout. A timeout must be an explicit blocked verdict with the timeout value in evidence, never silence. No live peer is contacted: the probe result is injected, and the judging logic runs for real.
inject: TCP probe result for 203.0.113.5:443 replaced by 'timeout' (5000 ms budget)
